description: This Java source file defines the 'BaseRetireHandler' class, which implements logic for retiring objects that implement the Retireable interface within the OpenMRS system. It handles setting the retired status, retire reason, who retired the object, and the date of retirement, primarily used in conjunction with AOP-based data handling.

classes.name: BaseRetireHandler
classes.description: Implements the RetireHandler interface for Retireable objects, handling the process of marking objects as retired, with logic to avoid overwriting retirement data if already set.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles retiring a Retireable object by setting its retired status, reason, who retired it, and the date of retirement based on current status and input parameters.
